hero.title: Know exactly where you stand before the real interview.
hero.subtitle: Upload your resume. Add the job description. Take a realistic AI interview. See where you are strong, where you are weak and what to improve.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Add your resume and the job description, or choose the role you are preparing for.
how.step2Body: A structured interview that goes deeper based on your answers, just like a real interviewer.
how.step3Body: Evidence-backed strengths and gaps, with a 24-hour, 3-day and 7-day improvement plan.

fair.title: Assessed on what you say and build
fair.body: Your answers, reasoning and code are what count. Accent, appearance and facial expressions are never scored.

wizard.title: New interview
wizard.subtitle: Tell us what you are preparing for. It takes about two minutes.

start.intro: We will read your inputs, work out what the role needs and plan a realistic interview for it. You will see the plan before anything starts.
start.resumeBody: It lets the interviewer ask about your own projects and experience.
start.jdBody: Paste it, upload it or share a link. It makes the interview match the job.
start.targetBody: If you do not have a job description, choosing the role is enough.
start.nextBody: We analyse the role (usually under a minute), show you the skills and rounds we plan to cover, and you choose how to take the interview.
start.privacy: Your files are private to your account. Contact details on your resume, such as your name, email or phone number, are not used in scoring.

resume.intro: Choose a resume you uploaded before or upload a new one. You can also continue without one.

setup.title: Set up your interview

TEXT.name: Text
TEXT.body: Read each question and type your answers.

VOICE.name: Voice
VOICE.body: Hear each question and answer by speaking.

VIDEO.name: Video
VIDEO.body: A face-to-face style interview with your camera on.

setup.languageHint: Auto-detect follows the language you use during the interview.
setup.creditsNote: Credits are only used when you start the interview.

ready.title: Your interview is ready
ready.body: Next, review the interview rules and start when you are ready.

cancel.title: Cancel this interview
cancel.body: Cancelling removes this interview plan from your list of active interviews. Your resume stays saved.

credits.title: Credits
credits.error: We could not load your credits. Please refresh the page.
credits.reserved_one: {{count}} held by an interview in progress
credits.note: Each interview uses 1 credit. If you end very early, the credit is returned.

start.title: Ready to begin?

rules.text: This is a text interview: read each question and type your answer.
rules.ownWords: Answer in your own words, as you would in a real interview. The interviewer may ask follow-up questions.
rules.noScores: You will not see scores during the interview. Your readiness report comes afterwards.
rules.connection: If you lose connection, your progress is saved and the clock stops. You have 10 minutes to reconnect; after that the interview is paused and you can resume it within 24 hours.

start.balanceError: We could not load your credit balance.
start.refundNote: Credits are only used if enough of the interview happens. If you end very early, the credit is returned.

errors.noCredits: You have no credits left, so this interview cannot start. Buying credits is coming soon.
errors.inProgress: You already have an interview in progress. Finish or end it before starting a new one.
errors.invalidState: This interview cannot be started now. Check its status on your dashboard.

room.shortcutHint: Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) to send.
room.waitingHint: You can answer as soon as the next question appears.
room.tooLong: Your answer is too long. Shorten it to {{max}} characters or fewer.
room.sendWhenBack: Your answer will be sent when the connection is back.
room.offlineTitle: You are offline. Your progress is saved
room.reconnectingBody: The interview clock is paused while you are away. You have 10 minutes to reconnect before the interview is paused.

problems.stale: The interview had already moved on, so that answer was not sent. Check the current question.
problems.sendFailed: We could not send your answer. Please try again.
problems.endFailed: We could not end the interview. Please try again.

room.notFound: This interview could not be found.
room.noScoresNote: No scores are shown during the interview. Answer as you would in a real one.

processing.title: Thank you for completing your interview
processing.body: Your readiness report is being prepared. This usually takes a few minutes; you can leave this page and come back from your dashboard.

expired.title: This interview has expired
expired.body: This interview expired after being paused for 24 hours.

failed.title: Sorry, something went wrong
failed.body: We are sorry: this interview could not be completed because of a problem on our side. Please start a new interview.

credit.REFUNDED: Your credit was returned because the interview ended early.

complete.stalled: This is taking longer than usual — our team has been notified; your answers are saved.

report.loadError: We could not open this report

notReady.title: Your report is not ready yet
notReady.body: We are still preparing this report. Check its progress, or come back in a few minutes.

report.assessedWeight: Scored on {{assessed}}% of the skills for this role; the rest did not have enough evidence.

insufficient.title: We could not give an overall score
insufficient.body: There were not enough answers or enough evidence in them to judge your readiness fairly. This often happens when an interview ends early or answers are very short. Try a full interview and answer each question with a concrete example.

confidence.title: Evidence confidence
confidence.explain: Confidence shows how much evidence the report is based on, not how well you did.

dimensions.title: Skills
dimensions.hint: Sorted from strongest to weakest. Open a skill to see the evidence and the questions behind its score.
dimensions.noEvidence: No evidence was recorded for this skill.
dimensions.question: From the question: {{question}}
dimensions.fallback: This skill was scored from the strength of the evidence only, without a detailed review.
dimensions.noRationale: There was not enough evidence to explain a score for this skill.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.empty: No clear strengths were found in this interview.

gaps.title: Gaps to work on
gaps.empty: No clear gaps were found in this interview.

feedback.interviewQuality: How good was the interview itself?
